kr-12vs.title: Pole: tapered spike on top
kr-12vs.summary: Most poles end in a tapered spike.

kr-1jir.title: Road: yellow-and-white speed bumps
kr-1jir.summary: Speed bumps are often painted yellow and white.

kr-2ft9.title: Pole: black-yellow diagonal stripes
kr-2ft9.summary: Utility poles almost always have black and yellow diagonal stripes near the bottom. They stop above the ground and look more yellow than Taiwan's.

differs.how: Stripes reach the ground and look more orange

kr-58U2.title: Sign: yellow triangle warnings
kr-58U2.summary: Triangular warning signs have a yellow background. Round prohibition signs like speed limits and yield signs have a white background.

kr-8REn.title: Sign: blue arrow-shaped street names on poles
kr-8REn.summary: Blue, arrow-shaped street signs hanging from a metal bar attached to utility poles.

kr-9dSM.title: Phone numbers: area codes rise going south
kr-9dSM.summary: Area codes grow towards the south, from 02 in the north to 064 on the southern island. The capital has the only two-digit code.

kr-B9By.title: Google car: small camera above brake light
kr-B9By.summary: A small camera sits above the car's brake light, in coverage northeast of Seoul and around Pohang.

kr-H0At.title: Language: Hangul, letters with circles
kr-H0At.summary: A very distinct script where many letters contain circles. That sets it apart from other East Asian writing systems.

kr-Jwgp.title: Road lines: yellow centre, white edges
kr-Jwgp.summary: Yellow middle lines and white outer lines.

kr-Mihv.title: Houses: traditional tiled roofs
kr-Mihv.summary: Many buildings have traditional tiled roofs with decorated corners and edges that curve slightly upward. Blue roofs are quite common.

kr-N0GR.title: Plate: green (old), white or yellow (new)
kr-N0GR.summary: Plates from before 2006 are short and green and still show up in coverage. Newer ones are white for private cars and yellow for commercial vehicles, short or long.

kr-WNFu.title: Google car: Gen 3, black, white or silver
kr-WNFu.summary: Nearly all coverage is the older Gen 3 camera (blurrier, softer colours). The back of the car is usually visible and is black, white or silver. It never has an antenna.

kr-Yc5y.title: Landscape: mountains almost always visible
kr-Yc5y.summary: Mostly mountainous. You nearly always see hills or mountains in the distance, and even flat areas show elevation on the horizon.

kr-Z2aO.title: Google car: Gen 2 camera in two big cities
kr-Z2aO.summary: The older Gen 2 camera (lower quality) is almost only in Seoul and Busan, plus a few highways, though most of that has been replaced.

kr-eD76.title: Sign: white text on green direction signs
kr-eD76.summary: Direction signs have white text on a green background.

kr-emG8.title: Sign: five-sided blue pedestrian crossing
kr-emG8.summary: Pedestrian crossing signs are blue and shaped like a pentagon.

kr-fM0T.title: Landscape: totally flat, yellow-green fields
kr-fM0T.summary: The area around Gimje is one of the only completely flat areas, with open yellow-green fields along almost every road.

kr-k7Qt.title: Walls: dark volcanic rock
kr-k7Qt.summary: The same island has many rock walls built of dark volcanic stone.

kr-ncQh.title: Landscape: volcanic island, dark soil
kr-ncQh.summary: A volcanic island with lots of dark volcanic soil, and volcanoes often visible in the distance.

kr-oOJ9.title: Houses: blue house-shaped address plates
kr-oOJ9.summary: Buildings have blue address plates shaped like little houses, with the full address in Hangul and Latin letters. Some areas have unique plates you can use to guess the region.

kr-rElj.title: Coverage: spotty, cities and big highways
kr-rElj.summary: Coverage is limited and spotty. Apart from large highways, most of it is in and around major cities.

kr-rh1W.title: Coverage: lots of autumn and winter
kr-rh1W.summary: A lot of coverage was taken in autumn and winter, though nicer spring and summer coverage is common too.

kr-syDX.title: Road: red block markings
kr-syDX.summary: You can sometimes see red block markings painted on the road.

kr-uhX5.title: Bollard: black-white wedge
kr-uhX5.summary: A black and white wedge-shaped bollard with a round yellow reflector on the front and a grey one on the back.

kr-uvcQ.title: Houses: red brick
kr-uvcQ.summary: Red brick is a very common building material.

kr-zUjA.title: Houses: address plate with big white top
kr-zUjA.summary: In the Hampyeong region, house number plates have a large white section at the top.
